content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Samagra Shiksha - Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalayas (KGBVs), Jangaon District, dated 9 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KGBV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KGBV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: 2 Head Cook, 3 Night Watch Woman, 3 Assistant Cook, 1 Attender, 1 Day Watch Woman.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KGBV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format; the notice does not say where the form is available) and send it to Office of the District Educational Officer, Jangaon District, by by hand, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹9,750 monthly honorarium for Head Cook, ₹9,750 monthly honorarium for Night Watch Woman, ₹9,750 monthly honorarium for Assistant Cook, ₹9,750 monthly honorarium for Attender, ₹9,750 monthly honorarium for Day Watch Woman.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Head Cook and Attender: 10th class pass. Assistant Cook (and Sweeper & Scavenger): 7th class pass. Women candidates only; local residents of the KGBV village get first preference, then candidates of the same mandal. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only women candidates are invited. First preference to local habitation/residential area candidates of the village where the KGBV is located. Thereafter other eligible candidates of the mandal of the KGBV are considered.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Examination on 15-11-2026 at 11.00 AM. Local village candidates get first preference, then candidates of the same mandal.

faq.question: Q8. Which places are covered by KGBV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KGBV Chowdaram, KGBV Lingala Ghanpur, KGBV Palakurthi, KGBV Raghunathpalli, KGBV Tharigoppula, Jangaon District.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Xerox copies of required educational qualification certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notification describes the engagement as: Contract.
